If MG02 is struggling with CPU or disk, that would impact the Tomcats, leading to higher memory usage and GC. So possible candidates are MG02 (due to high CPU and disk issues), Tomcat01/Tomcat02 (because of GC events), and perhaps Mysql01 (since there's a spike in connections).
